response.sql: WITH per_media AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804 AND Milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds <> 0 GROUP BY MediaTypeId) SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) AS avg_bytes_per_ms_of_media_types, AVG(track_count) AS avg_track_count_per_media_type FROM per_media;
